#131 round 3 is done. /tmp/wt-131 holds one commit, 751ec582 (73ab3c18 amended), on top of main aab1f210. It is not pushed and was not rebased.

I replaced the rewrite approach with an allowlist in extension_catalog.resolve_entry_source: a source outside the accepted forms is refused, never rewritten.

Accepted forms:
(A) A package requirement with no direct reference: a name, optionally with [extras] and a version specifier. Passed on unchanged.
(B) An absolute URL, passed on byte-identical (fragments, extras and a trailing marker kept): https://host, http://host, git+https/http/ssh/git://host, git+file:///, file:///, file://localhost/, git://host, ssh://host, git@host:path. Also 'name @' followed by an https, http, git+ or absolute file URL.
(C) A path: absolute, ~, or starting with ./ or ../ (also the Windows dot-backslash forms), with optional [extras]. A bare archive file name (9 suffixes) counts as relative. A relative path resolves against the local catalog file's physical directory and is refused in an https or git catalog. Absolute and ~ paths are accepted from any catalog. Every path must exist.

Refused, with a message naming the entry, the catalog and ACCEPTED_SOURCE_FORMS:
- 'name @' a relative path or bare word (with or without spaces);
- any file: URL that is not file:/// or file://localhost/, including file: alone, file:#subdirectory=, name @ file:x, and forms with #sha256 or [extras];
- git+file:x and URLs with no host;
- a source starting with '-';
- a relative path without ./, and a requirement with a marker;
- kept from earlier rounds: a bare name that exists beside the catalog, a package that exists in the cwd, and a path that vanished before install.

(D) The Resolved line, the Install-extension-from line, the no-backend message, the candidate list and every refusal now print through safe_for_terminal. The installer still gets the real path.
(E) Refresh caches the spec as registered (Catalog.registered_as, 'registeredAs' in the cache). resolve_entry matches the label, the location or registered_as, so --catalog catalog.json works from any cwd and the false '--refresh' hint no longer appears.
(F) There is one test row per declared archive suffix, plus a row pinning the suffix tuple.
(G) CHANGELOG, the guide and its bundled copy, ADR-0255 (new section 2 allowlist, section 8 round 2), the ADR-0188 note, the README row, docstrings and the commit message (new REVIEW ROUND 2 section) are all rewritten. Every number in the message was re-measured on this tree.

One existing test changed: #11's test_discover_install_resolved_source_with_leading_dash now asserts that '-weird-pkg' is refused. Its old premise was wrong, because the installer's argv has no '--' separator.

findings.title: P1 - a literal extras-shaped sibling redirects the install and the pin to a different wheel
findings.detail: Source './local_ext-1.0-py3-none-any.whl[feature]' in a local catalog. The real 1.0 wheel sits beside the catalog. A sibling symlink literally named 'local_ext-1.0-py3-none-any.whl[feature]' points to a valid 9.0 wheel in the scratch cwd. The catalog resolver checks the base wheel and returns its absolute path with extras. _path_extras (extension_install.py:347-355) then sees that the whole bracketed spelling exists, treats it as the path with no extras, and Path.resolve follows the symlink. Resolved/Install lines announce 1.0[feature], but the installer gets the 9.0 wheel without extras. Default verification stages and pins 9.0 even though a pin for 1.0 already exists. Offline uv given the original spec picks 1.0; given aelix's emitted argument it picks 9.0. A directory source with the same collision is redirected too. Categories 1, 2 and 3.

findings.title: P2 - 'index --relative --out -' measures from a symlinked catalog.json's target, not from the wheel directory
findings.detail: extension_install.py:2920-2935 sets the target to <wheel-dir>/catalog.json and measures from target.resolve().parent even when it writes to stdout. If a catalog.json symlink already exists beside the wheel and points elsewhere, the command emits '../../catdir/<wheel>' instead of './<wheel>'.
